bio: Nora Ashani is a graphic designer from Kosovo specialising in typography, editorial design as well as brand identity and visual communication with a passion and eagerness in exploring materiality and the vast extent to which materiality, such as collage, can communicate meaning and purpose. Nora focuses on being a compelling story teller constructing layered visual narratives that invites new readings and perspective – primarily through the method of re-contextualising found or existing materials. She approaches each project and brief with experimentation, curiosity and a clear conceptual direction, conveying meaning and intention in nuanced ways as well as visual engagement.

projects.title: Overstack
projects.description: Over-Stack – This project uses layered lino prints to mirror the experience of ADHD: overlapping thoughts, repeated language, shifting attention, and the constant tension between chaos and clarity.

projects.title: PhobiaFiles
projects.description: Phobia Files is a series and a collection of phobia that is in a style of a visual pamphlet/guide. The use of collage is intended to explore the extent in which materiality can communicate a concern but also guide a solution for those parents to embrace their phobias within their children. The visual and material choice addressees the seriousness of phobias through a approachable and harmless communication, as well as understanding, managing and communicating the emotional responses.

projects.title: ShakenNotStirred2
projects.description: Shaken Not Stirred – AQUA is a Martini Brand made for mindful moments... 0% alcohol and 100% taste. AQUA is created for health-conscious drinkers who choose intention over excess. AQUA is more than a drink. It's a place to belong in an exclusive world for those who choose differently.

projects.title: SmultringerPhotography2
projects.description: Smultringer – Smultringer is a playful display typeface defined by bold curves, sharp terminals, and a handcrafted rhythm. Designed and presented through a printed type specimen created in PaperClips.
